trigger: Subscribe mTLS identity mismatch after upgrade
summary: Fix round clobbered the pre-existing session.identity_mismatch verb (Subscribe stolen-session evidence, #1118, CC7.2); verb now emitted nowhere while its paired metric still fires
classification_rationale: Code contradicts audit-log.md and its own comment at :2250. Confirmed by orchestrator against origin/dev:1106. Also raised independently by compliance-officer (A-1).

trigger: Repeated OTA RPC with mismatched/absent cert identity on a strict listener
summary: Identity-deny writes a synchronous PG audit row per rejected RPC AHEAD of the only rate bound; unbounded claimed_agent_id length into ev.principal
classification_rationale: I5 raised to HIGH via rule (b): unbounded load on the serialised audit path.

trigger: Concurrent connections each opening up to the per-connection stream cap
summary: Fleet-wide bound caps memory and per-CONNECTION streams only; SetMaxThreads unset and connections uncapped, so Subscribe still holds an unbounded thread per session
classification_rationale: Partial false assurance vs the changelog/server-admin claim. Reinforced by architect.

trigger: --insecure-skip-client-verify deployment
summary: ota_admission_key takes idents.front() without the peer_cert_recognizer_ foreign-CA check the identity gate applies
classification_rationale: Peer can choose its own bucket or land in a victim's under an insecure-verify deployment.

trigger: unix: listen address
summary: The 'unknown' admission key is NOT unreachable as the comment claims; extract_peer_ip returns {} for non-ipv4/ipv6 schemes, collapsing the fleet onto one bucket
classification_rationale: Comment contradicts peer_ip.hpp:155. cross-platform refined: Linux/macOS-reachable, Windows-conditional.

trigger: set_clock_for_test racing a concurrent quota/watchdog call
summary: clock_ written under mu_ by set_clock_for_test, read outside mu_ by four methods
classification_rationale: REFUTED as a CI outcome by cpp-safety cs-3: no test creates a concurrent pair, so TSan will not flag it. Downgraded to INFO band.

trigger: YuzuOtaConcurrencyRejections fires and the operator follows the annotation
summary: Alert says 'check the server logs, which name the rejected peer'; the log line at agent_service_impl.cpp:2046 names no peer
classification_rationale: Second dangling evidence pointer: the prior round fixed the audit-store pointer and introduced this one. sre-5 sizes the operability consequence.

trigger: Any agent_id_missing rejection
summary: agent_id_missing is emitted but documented nowhere; audit-log.md states a CLOSED three-value reason list
classification_rationale: Required-doc item 5 (audit-action/reason table). Also raised by security-guardian sec-6.

trigger: A future member reorder in ServerImpl
summary: No routed-concern row for the watchdog lifetime invariant; its third part (agent_server_ declared after agent_service_) is asserted only in narrative prose in a different file
classification_rationale: Required-doc item 4. architect concurs and adds: also add an explicit stop_ota_watchdog() so correctness rests on an ordered call.

trigger: std::mutex::lock throwing inside ~Registration
summary: The erase() catch comment claims 'the sweeper re-checks cancelled before invoking it' — false; a leaked never-cancelled entry WILL be invoked on a destroyed ServerContext
classification_rationale: Latent UAF with no reachable trigger today; the comment's justification is factually wrong.

trigger: A throwing CancelFn or a lock failure inside sweep_once
summary: Sweeper thread body has no exception guard; a throw escapes the thread function to std::terminate with no diagnostic. register_transfer's CancelFn carries no noexcept contract
classification_rationale: set_on_evict documents such a contract; register_transfer does not.

trigger: Mutation: delete the burst clamp in refund()
summary: FALSE GREEN: the burst-clamp test refunds three times before any try_rate_only materialises the entry, so all three are no-ops and the case duplicates the one above it
classification_rationale: VERIFIED both ways: deleting the clamp left [quota] green 648/648; materialising the entry first made the same mutation fail.

trigger: N/A - coverage absence
summary: set_config has NO test at all - the method that exists precisely because the unique_ptr reseat was a UAF; also untested: ota_admission_key, set_on_evict wiring, empty agent_id, handler refund wiring
classification_rationale: Coverage gap on the remediation's own load-bearing change.

trigger: ota_quota_ map at max_tracked plus a stream of unseen keys (NAT source-port rotation)
summary: enforce_cap_locked is an O(n) scan under mu_ on every insert at capacity: MEASURED 167.2us at n=50000, capping the OTA plane at ~6000 admissions/sec
classification_rationale: Considered I5(b)->HIGH and declined; orchestrator concurs - the mutex is shared only with OTA admission, not with a security or data-integrity operation.

trigger: First post-upgrade fleet-wide update at a certless site behind one NAT egress
summary: No upgrade note for a breaking behaviour change: one shared bucket per NAT egress at capacity 20 / refill 1-per-min means a 500-device certless site takes ~8.3h to update, 5000 devices ~3.5 days
classification_rationale: I7 raised to HIGH: the omission conceals a breaking change. Required-doc item 2.

trigger: A 100 MiB binary on a link below ~0.93 Mbit/s
summary: The 900s transfer deadline implies a sustained ~0.93 Mbit/s floor; the slow-link guidance sits on --ota-chunk-write-deadline-secs, which at 64KiB/30s is 2.2 KiB/s and never binds
classification_rationale: Guidance points at the non-binding knob. consistency-auditor A-1 derives the same conclusion from artifact size.

trigger: Peer throughput below file_size/900s
summary: The two deadline defaults are mutually inconsistent: 900s/30s caps a slow transfer at 30 chunks = 1.875 MiB, but the shipped agent binary measures 2.95 MiB, so the chunk deadline can never bind; with no resume, a fleet below ~3.4 KB/s can never update
classification_rationale: VERIFIED by arithmetic against the measured artifact.

trigger: Any per-peer OTA rejection
summary: principal_quota_denial.hpp declares that every transport renders denials from one classify_quota_denial; the new gRPC gate is a third transport bypassing it - the honest retry_after_ms is only logged, never put on the wire
classification_rationale: REST peers get Retry-After; agents get nothing.

trigger: Any new RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED reaching the agent
summary: The client folds every non-OK download status into one UpdateError and sleeps update_check_interval (6h); a RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED with a ~1min honest retry hint costs a full 6h delay
classification_rationale: No spin or hot loop - the agent behaves safely. Provenance pre-existing: the client was not changed by this diff.

trigger: Sweeper blocked holding mu_, or sweep_interval<=0 constructing no thread
summary: The sweeper thread has no liveness signal - no metric, no /readyz entry, no explicit stop; if it wedges the #911 deadline silently stops being enforced
classification_rationale: observability-conventions requires this pattern twice (quarantine reconciler tick, rotation sweep).

trigger: One benign rejection anywhere in the fleet
summary: for: 10m is INERT - shorter than the [15m] lookback, so a single rejection pages; the annotation promises tolerance the rule does not have and the promtool case only tests a continuous series
classification_rationale: VERIFIED with promtool: one increment at t=2m fires at t=13m. severity_native SHOULD; derived LOW governs the gate.

trigger: Distinct source IPs reaching max_peers_tracked on a default install
summary: The peer map never shrinks (purge_stale has no caller, eviction is one-per-insert), so YuzuOtaPeerMapNearCapacity latches permanently with a server restart as the only recovery; purge_stale's doc comment now contradicts the code
classification_rationale: E1 raise rests on the identity gate being inert on the default install. Also: no gRPC latency histogram exists, so the cap working and the cap being the bottleneck have identical signatures.

trigger: Any YuzuOtaConcurrencyRejections page
summary: The #913 control has no path from page to peer: no audit row (deliberate), no identity in the log, no identity label on the metric
classification_rationale: Minimal fix is one line - add the admission key and mode to the existing spdlog::warn. Sampled audit and a top-N endpoint both explicitly rejected with reasons.

trigger: Enough simultaneous in-flight DownloadUpdate handlers to fill the map
summary: enforce_cap_locked's fail-open rests on a bound that does not exist: the header justifies it by the gRPC stream cap, but that cap is per-CONNECTION, connections are uncapped and SetMaxThreads is unset, so the map can grow unbounded
classification_rationale: The comment's justification is false. E1: unauthenticated reaches DownloadUpdate on the default install.

trigger: file.read() blocking on a degraded or network mount (UP-112)
summary: A hung package read permanently consumes that peer's concurrency slots: the watchdog cannot unblock a read and the QuotaSlot is held for the handler's life, so the peer gets RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED for the process lifetime
classification_rationale: I5(c) wedges a state machine. At --ota-max-concurrent-per-peer=1 a single hang is permanent.

trigger: A future runtime caller of set_ota_bound_config
summary: set_ota_bound_config's comment says 'Safe to call at any time'; ota_cfg_ is a plain struct read unsynchronised by handler threads per loop iteration and per transfer
classification_rationale: No live caller today; the defect is the false contract inviting one.

trigger: Mass re-image or cert re-issue changing CN vs agent_id on a strict deployment
summary: CheckForUpdate got the identity gate but NO admission gate, so a fleet-wide identity drift makes every agent's 6-hourly check write a synchronous PG audit row, unbounded, with no attacker required
classification_rationale: I5(b): persistent load on the serialised audit path. E0 - scales with fleet size, needs no actor. Distinct from sec-2.

trigger: Any refund that fails to land inside PrincipalQuota::refund
summary: YuzuOtaRefundDivergence cannot detect what it claims: both counters are incremented by adjacent unconditional lines, so it only catches a hand-edit; the failure it names happens inside refund() (find-not-insert), which the alert cannot see
classification_rationale: The advertised regression detector is largely decorative.

trigger: Transfers being aborted by either deadline
summary: yuzu_ota_download_deadline_exceeded_total has no alert at all, while three alerts cover lesser signals
classification_rationale: The one metric meaning 'transfers are being aborted' is unalerted.

trigger: --ota-transfer-deadline-secs below real transfer time on slow links
summary: A too-short transfer deadline is a SILENT fleet-wide update outage: every transfer aborts, every abort refunds, the agent retries on a 6h timer, so admissions climb, refunds match aborts and RefundDivergence stays quiet - the fleet stops updating and every dashboard is green
classification_rationale: The refund design is what guarantees the silence.

trigger: --ota-max-peers-tracked below the active peer count
summary: Setting max_peers_tracked below the active peer count silently DISABLES the rate dimension: eviction then re-insert mints a full-burst bucket via locate_locked, so every peer arrives with 20 tokens; at =1 the rate limiter is off entirely
classification_rationale: I1 - the rate control does not hold. No warning; _peers_evicted_total is the only tell and has no alert.

trigger: Synchronised deadline expiry during a fleet rollout
summary: sweep_once holds mu_ across EVERY TryCancel in the pass, and both register_transfer and ~Registration::erase need that mutex, so one sweep serialises the OTA plane
classification_rationale: The under-lock cancel is deliberate and load-bearing for the UAF argument; the cost is the pass width.

trigger: A gateway fanning a fleet in over one connection during a reconnect storm
summary: The 128-stream cap lands on the gateway-upstream listener too (shared ServerBuilder), bounding ProxyRegister/ProxyInventory/BatchHeartbeat for a whole fleet over one connection
classification_rationale: New head-of-line blocking on a path this diff was not aiming at.

trigger: An unauthenticated peer on a default install using multiple source addresses
summary: On the default install the identity gate is inert and admission keys on peer IP, so the bound scales with the attacker's address space: a /24 yields 512 concurrent full-binary transfers each holding a thread up to 900s
classification_rationale: Strictly better than the pre-diff unlimited case; recorded as 'not closed' rather than 'regressed'.

trigger: Mutation probes authorised on a worktree five agents were concurrently reading
summary: RUN-LEVEL: the orchestrator let quality-engineer run mutation probes on the shared worktree while five other Gate 3 agents read it; two agents independently observed transiently-mutated source
classification_rationale: Same class as the #2604 shared-stale-checkout failure. Findings touching ota_transfer_rules.hpp and principal_quota.cpp were re-verified by the orchestrator against the committed state.
